items.quote: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father
items.claim: Isaac re-dug the water wells that had first been dug in the time of his father Abraham.
items.object: the wells of water dug in the days of Abraham

items.quote: for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham
items.claim: After Abraham died, the Philistines stopped up the wells dug in his time, which is why Isaac had to dig them again.
items.object: the wells dug in the days of Abraham
items.mechanism: The wells were blocked after Abraham's death, so they had to be dug again.

items.quote: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them
items.claim: Isaac gave the re-dug wells the same names his father Abraham had given them.
items.object: the re-dug wells, named with Abraham's names for them
